TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
VETERANS COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
5:30 PM, NOVEMBER 4, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Veterans Commission, Town of Hamden, will hold a Regular 
Meeting on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 5:30 PM in-person at the Hamden 
Government Center, Recreation Conference Room. 
 
This meeting is not hybrid. Only held in-person.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE 
 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
  1. Approval of the October 7th meeting minutes. 
5. PUBLIC COMMENT / INTRODUCTION OF GUESTS 
 
6. CORRESPONDENCE 
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
 
8. REPORTS 
 
  1. The VAD Committee, Cal Shepard, and David Lewis. 
  2. Community Relations, Jim O'Neil. 
  3. Social media, Owen Arengberg. 
  4. Wreaths Across America, Bill Campton (CSS). 
9. OLD BUSINESS 
 
10. NEW BUSINESS 
 
  1. Announcements.
2. HAC Welcome and protocol manual, Cal Shepard.  
  3. Office Manning Schedule — Bill MacMullen.  
  4. HVC reached out to Whitney Center veterans — Cal Shepard.  
  5. Term limits. 
  6. Hamden Veterans Coalition. 
  7. Approval for 2027 annual meeting dates/calendar. 
11. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
